caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern of large yellow flowers with pale orange and cream highlights, surrounded by green leaves and smaller white blossoms. The flowers have brownish centers, and some of the petals are tinged with pink or light orange. The floral elements are distributed across a textured blue background with swirling, wavy lines and scattered circular motifs in lighter blue and white. The overall composition is dense, with the flowers and leaves overlapping and filling most of the available space within a square format on a cream-colored border.
title: Printed Textile
